name: password_reset_link

metadata.description: Password reset email containing the fully resolved frontend reset link used by on_user_forgot when method is 'link' or 'email'.
notes: `user` is a dict (user.to_dict('basic')) auto-injected by User.send_template_email if missing.
`token_url` is built server-side from tenant/project WEBAPP_BASE_URL and WEBAPP_AUTH_PATH settings, then may be shortened.
Keep wording neutral and avoid leaking account existence; the endpoint already returns a generic message.

text_template:
Hello{% if user.display_name %} {{ user.display_name }}{% endif %},

A password reset was requested for your account.

Open this secure link to choose a new password:
{{ token_url }}

This link expires soon and can be used only once.

If you didn't request a password reset, you can ignore this email.
html_template:
Reset your password

Hello{% if user.display_name %} {{ user.display_name }}{% endif %},

A password reset was requested for your account. Use the secure link below to choose a new password.

Reset password

If the button does not work, copy and paste this link into your browser:

{{ token_url }}

This link expires soon and can be used only once. If you didn't request a password reset, you can ignore this email.

Sent by Django-MOJO
